thread:
Ashley Tran: morning team, i'm taking the sunrise shift (primary). quick recap of what rolled over from last night: embed autoscaler thrash peaked ~02:15 UTC, we saw partial replica evictions and a secondary path fallback. customer-facing 503s for some heavy-parallel embedding jobs; most traffic recovered after autoscaler cooldown but a handful of orgs still reported intermittent errors.

Oncall Bot: INCIDENT #8452 created at 8043209100 — 'embed-autoscaler-thrash — partial evictions' assigned to ashley. severity: P2.

Ashley Tran: current status: autoscaler stable on primary cluster, eviction rate dropped to baseline, no active pages in the last 30m except repeated retries from one partner. customer impact: intermittent 503s for high-concurrency embedding jobs (5 orgs, highest rate src=partner-ml).

Mike Chen: noted. i'm secondary for this shift. i'll watch metrics and take lead if we see new pages. cc @Sofia for EU routing check — we have a small coverage gap for eu-west between 06:00-07:30 due to scheduled node maintenance (ops calendar).

Sofia Patel: confirmed — maintenance window is incremental and should not affect queued capacity, but if autoscaler trips we'll have reduced headroom. i've put a temporary weight on us-east to reduce pressure in eu-west. monitoring alerts adjusted.

Ashley Tran: short checklist for incoming shift people: 1) primary = ashley, secondary = mike. 2) runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-autoscaler (see section 'rapid fallback'). 3) playbook commands below if we need to force fallback:
```
# force fallback to cpu-only pool for embeddings (use sparingly)
redwood-cli routing set-priority --model embeddings-v2 --region eu-west --weight 0.2
redwood-cli pool scale --name cpu-fallback --min 10
```

Mike Chen: thanks — adding a note: if you hit >5% 5xx for >5m, escalate to oncall-sre (page). otherwise follow runbook. i've also opened a short-term canary to divert low-risk traffic to a quantized variant to keep latency up.

Oncall Bot: PagerDuty alert silenced for INCIDENT #8452 by Ashley Tran at 8043210120.

Ashley Tran: customer comms: support sent a proactive note to the 5 affected orgs — ticket refs: SUP-2134, SUP-2138. ops should keep those tickets updated every 30m until stable. I'll draft an internal blurb for cs.

Sofia Patel: obs notes: p95 latency for embeddings normalized to 180ms, p99 still edging up to 600ms under bursts. KV cache hit rate is ~88% (normal ~92) — possible cold starts for some batching lanes. keeping cache warmers on small batches for now.

Mike Chen: next steps for morning: 1) watch eviction rate for 30m; 2) if eviction >3 nodes within 10m, run the `eviction-dump` diag:
```
redwood-diagnostics eviction-dump --since 10m > /tmp/evict.log && scp /tmp/evict.log ops@infra:/tmp/
```
3) if repeated customer pages, enable short-term reserved pool for the affected orgs (ops ticket required).

Ashley Tran: handoff expectations to next shift (start 09:00 UTC): leave note in this thread + update runbook status. if everything stable, close incident after 2 hours of no 5xx spikes and confirm with cs that affected tickets are downgraded. i'm leaving a pinned snippet in the channel with the current link to the runbook and the top-of-thread summary.

PagerDuty: NOTE — next oncall rotation: Mike Chen becomes primary at 09:00 UTC.

Ashley Tran: thanks all. i'll keep monitoring for the next 45m then brief the handoff. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: got it. i'll be ready to take over. :eyes:

Sofia Patel: switching dashboards to eu-west + overlay for autoscaler metrics. ping here if you want an immediate handoff.

Ashley Tran: last log snippet before i start the watch:
```
2026-07-14T02:58:12Z [autoscaler] scale_loop: reduced_pending -> current_capacity=78 target=80 reason='cooldown'
2026-07-14T03:05:41Z [eviction] node-az3: eviction_count=1 triggered_by='mem_pressure'
2026-07-14T03:12:07Z [routing] fallback: embeddings-v2 -> embeddings-v2-quantized weight=0.15
```

Ashley Tran: end of initial handoff note.
